content:
maria-partnerships: kicking off an IaC pilot with our GCP marketplace partner. Goal: deliver a reference architecture, a reusable Terraform module, and a tiny sample app that can be used in the marketplace listing. timeline: 2 weeks for module, 1 week for docs. who can own the module?

aj-eng: I can take the terraform module. question: do we want multi-region support out of the gate or start single-region and iterate?

maria-partnerships: start single-region (us-central1) with clear notes for multi-region. include example for private VPC peering.

raj-arch: I'll draft the ref-arch diagram and include notes on autoscaling, reserved capacity (Dedicated), and KV/cache placement. will call out networking for private deployments.

sophie-devex: I'll own docs + quickstart + sample app README. can we reuse bits from infra-kit modules to speed up? Also need a short `main.tf` snippet to show consumption.

maria-partnerships: yes reuse where sensible. starter snippet (put this in the README):

```terraform
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source       = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/marketplace-iac.git//modules/gcp?ref=main"
  project      = var.project
  region       = var.region
  private_vpc  = true
  instance_type = "n1-standard-8"
}
```

aj-eng: lgtm. we'll add outputs for `load_balancer_ip` and `service_account_email`. also will include a `variables.tf` example.

kevin-ml: partner's infra team asked for hardware recommendations — call out Ampere vs x86 and quantization-friendly choices. add an ops note for provisioning quantized endpoints on Ampere nodes.

chris-legal: heads-up: I'll need the dataflow diagram before external partner review for the marketplace listing. ping me when the diagram is ready.

deploy-bot: terraform-lint job queued: `marketplace-iac/ci/terraform-lint` (job id: 7892).

sophie-devex: timeline check — I'll have the first doc + sample app draft by 1815043280.

raj-arch: arch diagram PDF by 1815043250 and will drop links to diagrams in the thread.

maria-partnerships: awesome. tagging @aj-eng @sophie-devex @raj-arch @kevin-ml. next sync: tomorrow 11:00am PT. please add any blockers to the thread. :thumbsup:
